items.name: chapter-list
items.title: Chapter List
items.description: Chapter index for a series: one item row per chapter, read titles struck through, the latest stamped; Latin or Japanese numerals.

items.name: spread-viewer
items.title: Spread Viewer
items.description: Two-page manga spread reader: facing pages in ink frames, folios, a page turn, buttons, arrow keys and swipe; right to left by default.

items.name: character-card
items.title: Character Card
items.description: Cast entry: portrait in an ink frame with a status stamp, the name with its reading as ruby, role, a line of dialogue and stats as power gauges, on a card.

items.name: volume-grid
items.title: Volume Grid
items.description: A series' volumes as covers: 2:3 ink frames on a panel grid, a folio for each volume number, NEW stamps; Latin or Japanese numerals, lazy covers below the first row.

items.name: reader
items.title: Reader
items.description: A chapter page: the spread viewer, a drawer with the series' chapter list, progress as text, the page kept in the address through use-reader; made of two blocks.

items.name: login-01
items.title: Login 01
items.description: A login page: email and password on a paper card with a heavy ink outline, the title in the display face and a reception stamp; stock's login-01 in ink.

items.name: login-02
items.title: Login 02
items.description: A split-screen login page: the studio's mark and the form on paper, the title in the display face, beside a manga panel of halftone, focus lines and one sound effect; stock's login-02 in ink.

items.name: login-03
items.title: Login 03
items.description: A login card on tone-1 paper: Apple and Google first, then email and password, the card at the heavy outline and the title in the display face, stock's marks in ink; stock's login-03 in ink.

items.name: login-04
items.title: Login 04
items.description: A login card with a cover panel: the form beside a manga panel of halftone, focus lines and one sound effect, three social marks in ink; stock's login-04 in ink.

items.name: login-05
items.title: Login 05
items.description: An email-only login: the studio's mark in ink above the title in the display face, one email field, Apple and Google in ink; stock's login-05 in ink.

items.name: signup-01
items.title: Signup 01
items.description: A sign-up page: name, email and two passwords on a paper card with a heavy ink outline, the title in the display face and a registration stamp; stock's signup-01 in ink.

items.name: signup-02
items.title: Signup 02
items.description: A split-screen sign-up page: the studio's mark and the form on paper, the title in the display face, beside a manga panel of halftone, focus lines and one sound effect; stock's signup-02 in ink.

items.name: signup-03
items.title: Signup 03
items.description: A sign-up card on tone-1 paper: name, email and two passwords side by side, the card at the heavy outline and the title in the display face; stock's signup-03 in ink.

items.name: signup-04
items.title: Signup 04
items.description: A sign-up card with a cover panel: the form beside a manga panel of halftone, focus lines and one sound effect, three social marks in ink; stock's signup-04 in ink.

items.name: signup-05
items.title: Signup 05
items.description: An email-only sign-up: the studio's mark in ink above the title in the display face, one email field, Apple and Google in ink; stock's signup-05 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-01
items.title: Sidebar 01
items.description: A handbook's app shell: an edition menu, a search field and the sections as labelled groups of links, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-01 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-02
items.title: Sidebar 02
items.description: A handbook's app shell whose sections open and close: an edition menu, a search field and collapsible groups of links, beside a sticky header and a storyboard of blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-02 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-03
items.title: Sidebar 03
items.description: A handbook's app shell with submenus: every section a link with its pages beneath it on an ink guide rule, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-03 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-04
items.title: Sidebar 04
items.description: A handbook's app shell with a floating sidebar: a heavy-outlined paper card off the page's edge, every section with its pages beneath it, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-04 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-05
items.title: Sidebar 05
items.description: A handbook's app shell with collapsible submenus: a search field and sections that open and close their pages, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-05 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-06
items.title: Sidebar 06
items.description: A handbook's app shell whose sections open as menus, with the studio letter's sign-up card at the sidebar's foot, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-06 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-07
items.title: Sidebar 07
items.description: An app shell whose sidebar collapses to icons: a studio switcher, collapsible sections, series with their menus and the editor's account menu, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-07 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-08
items.title: Sidebar 08
items.description: An inset app shell with a secondary nav: the studio's mark, sections whose chevrons open their links, series with their menus, support links at the foot and the editor's account menu, beside a volume's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-08 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-09
items.title: Sidebar 09
items.description: Nested sidebars, mail-style: an icon rail of mailboxes and, beside it, the open mailbox's letters from a manga studio's editor, assistants and printer, with an Unreads switch and a search field; stock's sidebar-09 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-10
items.title: Sidebar 10
items.description: A notes-app shell: a studio switcher, main links, favourite notes and workspaces of pages in the sidebar, the note's actions in a popover in the header, beside the note's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-10 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-11
items.title: Sidebar 11
items.description: An app shell with a file tree: a chapter's changed files with their state, then its folders, opening on the page being drawn, beside that page's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-11 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-13
items.title: Sidebar 13
items.description: A sidebar inside a settings dialog: a manga reader's settings sections beside the open section's blank manga panels, opened from the page's button; stock's sidebar-13 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-14
items.title: Sidebar 14
items.description: A handbook page with its table of contents in a sidebar on the right, every section with its pages beneath it, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-14 in ink, server-only.

items.name: library-page
items.title: Library Page
items.description: A reader's library inside sidebar-07's app shell: the chapters they have open as cards with a cover, a progress bar and a Resume link, then shelves of volume covers, an empty shelf showing what to do next.

items.name: chat-thread
items.title: Chat Thread
items.description: A conversation: speech bubbles grouped by author, date and unread lines, attachments, reactions, a composer and a jump-to-latest button; new messages announced once; state through use-chat-thread.

items.name: series-page
items.title: Series Page
items.description: A manga series' home page: the cover with a status stamp, title, credits, synopsis, Start reading and Follow, then tabs of volumes, chapters and cast; made of three blocks.

items.name: sidebar-12
items.title: Sidebar 12
items.description: A schedule shell whose sidebar holds a month calendar: the editor's account menu, a date picker and the studio's collapsible calendars, beside a month of blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-12 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-15
items.title: Sidebar 15
items.description: A notebook shell between two sidebars: on the left a studio switcher, main links, favourite notes, collapsible workspaces and help links; on the right the editor's account menu, a date picker and the studio's calendars; both put away with one shortcut, beside a note of blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-15 in ink.

items.name: sidebar-16
items.title: Sidebar 16
items.description: An app shell under a sticky site header: the header's sidebar toggle, breadcrumb and search stay above a sidebar of collapsible sections, series with their menus, help links and the editor's account menu, beside a chapter's blank manga panels; stock's sidebar-16 in ink.

items.name: settings-01
items.title: Settings 01
items.description: Account settings for a signed-in reader: a section nav and four cards (account, notifications, reading, danger zone) with selects, switches, radio groups and a direction toggle; Save validates and announces, Delete account asks first.

items.name: profile-01
items.title: Profile 01
items.description: Profile editing for a signed-in reader: a public profile card (initials avatar with a photo preview, name, @username, bio with a live count, interests as tags, website) and a password card with a strength meter; each Save validates and announces.

items.name: onboarding-01
items.title: Onboarding 01
items.description: A first-run flow in a card: a linear stepper over Profile, Interests and Habits, each validated on Next with focus to the first invalid field, then a summary of the answers and a link to the library.

items.name: file-manager-01
items.title: File Manager 01
items.description: A file manager for a manga project: a folder tree (series, volumes, chapters, covers, scripts), a breadcrumb, the open folder as a table with Rename, Download and Delete per file, and Upload or a drop over the list to add files; every change is announced.

items.name: activity-01
items.title: Activity 01
items.description: A reader's own activity page: four stat cards with sparklines, a filter by kind that announces its count, and a timeline of events under day headings with Show more.

items.name: upload-01
items.title: Upload 01
items.description: A chapter upload page: series, chapter number and title in a card, a drop zone for up to 40 page images with per-page progress and retry, an overall count, and Upload, Cancel and Publish; the upload is simulated and Publish validates and announces.
